text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six months as indicated 
by M6
in the above title block.
This document initiated and tested by by eng. Mohamed Ahmed Ezzy, reviewed by eng Marcus Estasious Condis, revised by EDEPC quality control 
eng. Tawfeq Al Abasery, approved by operation and 
maintenance's General Director: eng. Nabel Al Bastawesy, 
and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection and quality control head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Personal
 protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, Helmet, breathing mask,
 safety glasses).
Switch off input and output 
 supply.
Circuit breaker 
 must be isolated and earthed.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set, Digital voltmeter.
Complete tool set, Digital voltmeter.
Brush, Air blower or vacuum 
 cleaner.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the outside CB surface to remove contaminant particles.
Check for loose bolts and tighten if needed.
Check the SF6 pressure value.
Clean mechanical 
 parts and electrical switches (contacts).
Check the closing and tripping coils (operations).
Check the possibility of easy motion for the breakers.
Check the operation of charging motor and charging of spring.

مقدمة
